versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the verified-humanizer skill.
- Added documentation and usage guidelines (README.md, SKILL.md).
- Included assets for rewrite checklists and transformation reporting.
- Provided example references and integration notes.
- Added hooks for Openclaw integration.
- Introduced scripts for text activation and scanning.

- Initial release of verified-humanizer skill.
- Transforms formulaic AI-generated text into more natural, human-sounding writing.
- Provides local evaluation of before/after changes with measurable metrics.
- Supports optional, privacy-preserving verification using only structured evaluation data.
- Keeps rewriting local and ensures user privacy by default.
- Output includes rewritten text, change log, evaluation data, and optional verification status.
